purpose: Define rollback as explicit restoration/activation of a previously accepted immutable snapshot, preserving evidence and never synthesizing a hybrid tree from old and new active sources.

value.target_rule: Rollback target is an exact previously accepted snapshot/release identity.
value.atomic_rule: Rollback activates a coherent snapshot according to repository replacement policy.
value.hybrid_rule: Rollback must not leave mixed active definitions from incompatible snapshots.
value.evidence_rule: Rollback target retains its original validation evidence; environment/runtime compatibility may require fresh activation checks.
value.audit_rule: Rollback action records source release, target release/snapshot, authority and reason.
value.forward_rule: Subsequent fixes create a new candidate snapshot rather than mutating the rolled-back accepted snapshot.
